=== ANTI-007 ===
---
id: ANTI-007
title: "Async persistence mental models produce systematic accuracy errors in event-based documentation"
type: anti-pattern
confidence: low
domains: ["api-reference", "xperience-platform", "activity-logging"]
discoveredDate: "2026-03-15T06:23:39Z"
lastReferencedDate: "2026-03-15T06:23:39Z"
usageCount: 1
sourceTasks: ["T-005", "T-010", "T-011"]
invariantsReferenced: []
sourceSignals: ["SIG-006", "DI-007"]
deprecated: false
---

## Insight

Writers naturally assume synchronous database persistence when documenting logging/event services, but Xperience activity logging uses in-memory queuing with bulk inserts. This mental model mismatch produced ALL accuracy errors in the DOC-3137 run: T-010 wrote "saved to the database" (actually queued in memory), "ActivityID is available" (actually 0 at event fire time). T-011 used misleading "standard pipeline" label. T-005 attributed email clicks to wrong pipeline path.

## Evidence

- T-010: 4 accuracy errors all stemming from incorrect persistence mental model
- T-011: misleading "standard pipeline" label for email click logging
- T-005: 2 pipeline behavior errors (wrong logging path for email clicks, incomplete form submission path)
- All accuracy errors in this run were persistence/pipeline-semantics related
- Signal strength: medium (3 tasks, systematic pattern)
- Confidence: low (first observation in a single run)

## Recommendation

For any task documenting event timing, data flow, or pipeline stages, the writer should be briefed with a docFact covering the async persistence model. Prohibited language: "saved to database", "persisted", "stored" without qualification. Required framing: "queued in memory" or "logged" (not "saved").

## Applicability

Applicable to Xperience activity logging documentation and generalizable to any event/pipeline documentation where the persistence model is async or batched.

=== DOM-002 ===
---
id: DOM-002
title: "Hub/index pages require manual enumeration updates when new pages are created"
type: domain-insight
confidence: medium
domains: ["api-reference", "page-creation", "xperience-platform", "cross-references", "impact-analysis"]
discoveredDate: "2026-03-14T16:06:35+00:00"
lastReferencedDate: "2026-03-15T06:23:39Z"
usageCount: 3
sourceTasks: []
invariantsReferenced: []
sourceSignals: ["SIG-R2-metaknowledge", "CTXGAP-002", "CTXDOM-002"]
deprecated: false
mergedFrom: ["DOM-005"]
---

## Insight

Xperience documentation uses manual hub/index pages (e.g., content-item-api.md) that enumerate sub-pages in prose. When new pages are created in a directory, the parent index page must be updated manually. The cross-ref-updater only verifies existing page_link references — it does not detect missing enumeration entries on hub pages. Future runs creating new pages should auto-generate an impact for the parent directory's index page.

## Evidence

### Run 2 (DOC-3137)

- Run 2 (DOC-3137): T-004 (hub page update) and T-005 (set-up-activities update) both addressed hub enumeration correctly. DOM-002 guidance applied successfully.
- Acceptance rate across 2 runs: confirmed
- Promoted: low → medium (2nd pipeline run confirmation)

### Run 1 (original)

- Source signal: CTXGAP-002 (gap analysis) + CTXDOM-002 (domain insight analysis) — converging signals from two independent analyzers
- Within-run strength: moderate (2 independent observations from different analysis passes)
- GAP-002 found content-item-api.md (hub page) did not list the new reference-content-access-settings.md
- Cross-ref-updater added 3 new page_links but did not detect the missing hub enumeration
- The verification matrix shows 477 outbound links verified but this is link-validation, not completeness-checking of hub page inventories
- Confidence: low (cold-start run — converging within-run evidence, but needs second run confirmation for medium)

## Recommendation

When the impact mapper identifies a create-action (new page) task, automatically generate a secondary impact for the parent directory's hub/index page. The cross-ref-updater should be extended to check hub page enumeration completeness, not just link validity.

## Applicability

Applicable to any Xperience documentation pipeline run that creates new pages. Hub pages exist for API reference areas, how-to guide collections, and conceptual overview sections. This pattern will recur whenever the change inventory includes new API surfaces requiring new documentation pages.

=== DOM-013 ===
---
id: DOM-013
title: "Xperience activity logging dual-pipeline architecture (Log vs LogWithoutModifiersAndFilters) is the primary accuracy hazard"
type: domain-insight
confidence: low
domains: ["api-reference", "xperience-platform", "activity-logging"]
discoveredDate: "2026-03-15T06:23:39Z"
lastReferencedDate: "2026-03-15T06:23:39Z"
usageCount: 1
sourceTasks: ["T-001", "T-005", "T-010", "T-011"]
invariantsReferenced: []
sourceSignals: ["DI-001", "DI-004"]
deprecated: false
---

## Insight

Xperience has two activity logging pipeline paths: (1) Standard Log — runs filters, then modifiers, then validators. Used for in-app tracking (page visits, landing pages, form submissions with full consent, custom activities). (2) LogWithoutModifiersAndFilters — runs only validators. Used for cross-site tracking, certain form submissions (legitimate interest), member registration. Cross-site tracking via CrossSiteActivityLogger bypasses modifiers entirely, creating a documentation coverage blind spot for modifier limitations. This dual-pipeline was the source of 3 accuracy rejections in the DOC-3137 run.

## Evidence

- T-005: misattributed email click to "Modifiers and validators" (actually validators-only)
- T-010: claimed activities are "saved to database" (actually queued in memory)
- T-011: used "standard activity logging pipeline" for an email click path that uses LogWithoutModifiersAndFilters
- Code analysis: ActivityLogService has 2 distinct pipeline paths
- Signal strength: high (4 tasks affected, systematic pattern)
- Confidence: low (first observation in a single run)

## Recommendation

Future documentation runs touching activity logging MUST include a pre-writing docFact with: (1) explicit lookup table of activity type → pipeline path, (2) which hooks run on each path, (3) persistence model (async memory queue, not sync DB write).

## Applicability

Directly applicable to any future documentation task involving Xperience activity logging, digital marketing, or cross-site tracking. The dual-pipeline pattern may also apply to other Xperience service architectures.

Directly applicable to any future pipeline run creating pages in the _api collection. May generalize to other specialized collections with non-standard conventions.

id: DOM-015
title: "ActivityEvaluationRegister uses non-standard singleton factory registration pattern"
type: domain-insight

## Insight

IActivityModifier, IActivityLogValidator, and IActivityLogFilter are NOT registered through standard DI/RegisterImplementation. They use ActivityEvaluationRegister.Instance (a custom singleton registry) with factory lambda registration called from Module.OnInit() methods. This is the only extensibility point in the analyzed Xperience codebase using this registration mechanism — all other service registrations use RegisterImplementation attributes or IServiceCollection DI. ActivityEvaluationRegister is in CMS.Activities.Internal (pubternal), making the registration mechanism itself unsupported for public documentation.

## Evidence

- Codebase map: ActivityEvaluationRegister.Instance.Modifiers.Register(() => new MyModifier())
- T-001 warning callout (lines 219-225) documents this unique pattern
- 4 internal modules use this pattern (code analysis AREA-003)
- Signal strength: medium
- Confidence: low (first observation in a single run)

## Recommendation

Future runs documenting Xperience extensibility points should check whether the registration mechanism matches the standard DI pattern or uses a unique one. Non-standard registration patterns need explicit documentation callouts and potential pubternal framing.

## Applicability

Directly applicable to Xperience activity logging documentation. Generalizable principle: check registration mechanism for any new extensibility point documentation.

# DOC-3137 Task Retrospective

**Task**: Document public APIs for activity logging customization (IActivityModifier, IActivityLogValidator)
**Completed**: 2026-03-15T06:23:39Z
**Pipeline run**: 2 (second run; prior: member-roles-content-access-security)

## Run Statistics

| Metric | Value |
|---|---|
| Total tasks | 16 |
| First-attempt acceptance | 9 (56.25%) |
| Multi-cycle acceptance | 7 (43.75%) |
| Blocked tasks | 0 |
| Total writer attempts | 25 |
| Total review cycles | 65 |
| Average review cycles/task | 4.1 |
| Gap hunting cycles | 3 |
| Gaps found | 4 |
| Gaps resolved | 3 |
| Gaps force-converged | 1 |

## What Worked

1. **Meta-knowledge briefing was effective**: 3 of 5 briefed patterns were actively used by writers, and all tasks citing them achieved first-attempt success. PAT-001 (single-persona focus), PAT-002 (high invariant count), and PAT-004 (formatting focus) proved valuable.

2. **Anti-pattern explicit citation by T-009**: T-009 proactively cited ANTI-002 (em dash avoidance) and achieved first-attempt success. This demonstrated that anti-pattern awareness in the writer's output is a reliable mitigation.

3. **Enumerated acceptance criteria (ANTI-004 mitigation)**: Task planner enumerated IActivityModifier.Modify() and IActivityLogValidator.IsValid() explicitly. No methods were missed — a successful application of the ANTI-004 mitigation from the prior run.

4. **Hub page enumeration (DOM-002)**: T-004 and T-005 correctly handled hub page updates. DOM-002 guidance from the knowledge brief was applied successfully.

5. **Business-user persona handling (DOM-008)**: T-012 applied 29 invariants including 4 persona-specific ones and a research recommendation (REC-016), achieving first-attempt success on a cross-persona page.

6. **Prohibited content enforcement**: TINV-001 (IActivityLogFilter exclusion) was applied across 14/16 tasks. Zero IActivityLogFilter mentions in final output. Pubternal framing (CMS.Activities.Internal) was corrected via GAP-001.

7. **Cross-ref update efficiency**: 3 of 4 cross-ref update tasks achieved first-attempt success. This task type is well-suited for parallel execution.

## What Didn't Work

1. **_api collection convention blind spot (GAP-003)**: T-002 and T-003 were completely rewritten because the _api collection's code-examples-only convention was not captured in invariants or sibling analysis. This was the costliest rework in the run (2 complete page rewrites + 2 companion .cs file creations).

2. **Em dash persistence (ANTI-002)**: Despite being in the knowledge brief, 3 tasks (T-010, T-011, T-016) still had em dash rejections. The anti-pattern was only effective when explicitly cited by the writer (T-009). Passive awareness is insufficient.

3. **Activity logging persistence mental model**: Writers assumed synchronous database persistence. All accuracy errors in this run stemmed from incorrect persistence/pipeline mental models. The dual-pipeline (Log vs LogWithoutModifiersAndFilters) distinction was systematically misapplied.

4. **Cascade effects from structural fixes**: GAP-003's structural rewrite of T-002/T-003 cascaded into GAP-004 (stale link text). Content fixes resolved cleanly but structural fixes created secondary gaps.

5. **Link text semantic accuracy**: Cross-ref updater validated link target existence but not link text accuracy against destination content. GAP-004 went undetected until cycle 3.

## Lessons Learned

1. **Sibling page audit is mandatory for new pages**: The task planner must include a structural template acceptance criterion derived from analyzing 2-3 sibling pages in the same collection directory. This would have prevented GAP-003 entirely.

2. **Anti-patterns need injection, not just awareness**: Including anti-patterns in the brief is insufficient. They must be injected as per-task invariant items that the writer explicitly acknowledges. T-009's explicit citation pattern should be mandated.

3. **Domain-specific persistence models need docFacts**: Async persistence (memory queue → bulk insert) is non-obvious and produces systematic accuracy errors. Any documentation touching event/logging systems needs a pre-writing docFact on the persistence model.

4. **Structural rewrites trigger cascade risk**: When gap hunting discovers a structural convention violation, re-entry should include cascade-risk assessment covering all incoming link texts and content promises.

import json
from datetime import datetime, timezone

NOW = "2026-03-15T08:22:28Z"
now_dt = datetime.fromisoformat(NOW.replace("Z", "+00:00"))

# Task profile
task_domains = {"api-reference", "xperience-platform", "how-to"}

# Load index
with open("/workspace/.docwriter/meta/index.json") as f:
    index = json.load(f)

entries = index["entries"]
total_entries = len(entries)

# Compute max usage count for normalization
max_usage = max((e.get("usageCount", e.get("usage_count", 0)) for e in entries), default=1)
if max_usage == 0:
    max_usage = 1

def compute_score(entry):
    # Domain overlap
    e_domains = set(entry.get("domains", []))
    overlap = e_domains & task_domains
    if not overlap:
        domain_score = 0.0
    elif e_domains <= task_domains:  # full subset
        domain_score = 1.0
    else:
        domain_score = 0.5

    # Confidence
    conf = entry.get("confidence", "low")
    conf_score = {"high": 1.0, "medium": 0.6, "low": 0.3}.get(conf, 0.3)

    # Recency
    last_ref = entry.get("lastReferencedDate", entry.get("last_referenced_date", ""))
    if last_ref:
        try:
            ref_dt = datetime.fromisoformat(last_ref.replace("Z", "+00:00"))
            days = (now_dt - ref_dt).days
        except:
            days = 999
    else:
        days = 999

    if days < 30:
        recency_score = 1.0
    elif days < 90:
        recency_score = 0.7
    elif days < 180:
        recency_score = 0.4
    else:
        recency_score = 0.2

    # Usage frequency
    usage = entry.get("usageCount", entry.get("usage_count", 0))
    usage_score = usage / max_usage

    # Weighted
    score = 0.40 * domain_score + 0.25 * conf_score + 0.20 * recency_score + 0.15 * usage_score
    return round(score, 3)

# Score all non-deprecated entries
scored = []
for e in entries:
    if e.get("deprecated", False):
        continue
    score = compute_score(e)
    scored.append((score, e))

# Sort by score descending
scored.sort(key=lambda x: -x[0])

# Filter by threshold
threshold = 0.4
included = [(s, e) for s, e in scored if s >= threshold]
truncated = len(included) > 20
if truncated:
    included = included[:20]

# Staleness detection (all recent, none stale)
stale_entries = []
for s, e in scored:
    last_ref = e.get("lastReferencedDate", "")
    usage = e.get("usageCount", 0)
    conf = e.get("confidence", "low")
    if last_ref:
        try:
            ref_dt = datetime.fromisoformat(last_ref.replace("Z", "+00:00"))
            days = (now_dt - ref_dt).days
        except:
            days = 0
    else:
        days = 0
    if days > 90 and usage < 3:
        stale_entries.append({"id": e["id"], "reason": "stale", "daysSinceReferenced": days, "usageCount": usage})
    elif conf == "high" and days > 180:
        stale_entries.append({"id": e["id"], "reason": "decaying", "daysSinceReferenced": days})

# Conflict detection
conflicts = []

# File path mapping
path_map = {
    "pattern": "meta/patterns",
    "anti-pattern": "meta/anti-patterns",
    "domain-insight": "meta/domain-insights",
    "style-evolution": "meta/style-evolutions",
    "source-observation": "meta/source-observations",
    "task-retro-lesson": "meta/task-retros"
}

# Consumer mapping
consumer_map = {
    "pattern": ["task-planner", "content-writer"],
    "anti-pattern": ["style-reviewer", "gap-hunter"],
    "domain-insight": ["accuracy-reviewer", "task-planner"],
    "source-observation": ["code-analyzer", "task-planner", "gap-hunter"],
    "style-evolution": ["style-reviewer", "content-writer"],
    "task-retro-lesson": ["task-planner", "gap-hunter"]
}

# Build knowledge sections from file content
# For each entry, read the file and extract key info
import os

def read_entry_file(entry):
    etype = entry["type"]
    eid = entry["id"]
    dir_name = path_map.get(etype, "")
    fpath = f"/workspace/.docwriter/{dir_name}/{eid}.md"
    if os.path.exists(fpath):
        with open(fpath) as f:
            return f.read()
    return None

def extract_insight(content):
    """Extract the ## Insight section"""
    if not content:
        return ""
    lines = content.split("\n")
    in_insight = False
    result = []
    for line in lines:
        if line.strip().startswith("## Insight"):
            in_insight = True
            continue
        elif line.strip().startswith("## ") and in_insight:
            break
        elif in_insight:
            result.append(line)
    return "\n".join(result).strip()

def extract_recommendation(content):
    """Extract the ## Recommendation section"""
    if not content:
        return ""
    lines = content.split("\n")
    in_rec = False
    result = []
    for line in lines:
        if line.strip().startswith("## Recommendation"):
            in_rec = True
            continue
        elif line.strip().startswith("## ") and in_rec:
            break
        elif in_rec:
            result.append(line)
    return "\n".join(result).strip()

def extract_invariants_from_content(content):
    """Extract INV-* references"""
    if not content:
        return []
    import re
    return list(set(re.findall(r'INV-[a-zA-Z]+-\d+', content)))

def build_entry_brief(score, entry):
    content = read_entry_file(entry)
    insight = extract_insight(content)
    recommendation = extract_recommendation(content)
    inv_refs = entry.get("invariantsReferenced", [])
    if not inv_refs and content:
        inv_refs = extract_invariants_from_content(content)
    
    # Determine applicability for this task
    e_domains = set(entry.get("domains", []))
    overlap = e_domains & task_domains
    if overlap == task_domains:
        applicability = "Directly applicable — full domain match with current task"
    elif "api-reference" in overlap and "xperience-platform" in overlap:
        applicability = "Directly applicable — matches api-reference + xperience-platform domains"
    elif "api-reference" in overlap:
        applicability = "Applicable — matches api-reference domain of current task"
    elif "how-to" in overlap and "xperience-platform" in overlap:
        applicability = "Applicable — matches how-to + xperience-platform domains"
    elif "xperience-platform" in overlap:
        applicability = "Contextually relevant — matches xperience-platform domain"
    elif "how-to" in overlap:
        applicability = "Contextually relevant — matches how-to domain"
    else:
        applicability = "General pipeline knowledge — no direct domain overlap"

    # Build combined insight (truncate to ~200 words)
    combined = insight
    if recommendation and "See insight above" not in recommendation:
        combined += "\n\nRecommendation: " + recommendation
    
    words = combined.split()
    if len(words) > 200:
        combined = " ".join(words[:200]) + "..."

    return {
        "id": entry["id"],
        "title": entry.get("title", ""),
        "insight": combined,
        "applicability": applicability,
        "invariantsReferenced": inv_refs,
        "confidence": entry.get("confidence", "low"),
        "relevanceScore": score,
        "sourceTask": ", ".join(entry.get("sourceTasks", [])) if entry.get("sourceTasks") else "N/A",
        "usageCount": entry.get("usageCount", 0),
        "consumers": consumer_map.get(entry["type"], [])
    }

# Group entries by type
patterns = []
anti_patterns = []
domain_insights = []
source_observations = []
style_evolutions = []
task_retro_lessons = []

for score, entry in included:
    brief_entry = build_entry_brief(score, entry)
    etype = entry["type"]
    if etype == "pattern":
        patterns.append(brief_entry)
    elif etype == "anti-pattern":
        anti_patterns.append(brief_entry)
    elif etype == "domain-insight":
        domain_insights.append(brief_entry)
    elif etype == "source-observation":
        source_observations.append(brief_entry)
    elif etype == "style-evolution":
        style_evolutions.append(brief_entry)
    elif etype == "task-retro-lesson":
        task_retro_lessons.append(brief_entry)

# Build the brief
brief = {
    "version": 1,
    "generatedAt": NOW,
    "taskProfile": {
        "domains": sorted(list(task_domains)),
        "docTypes": ["api-reference", "how-to"],
        "changeScope": "documentation-gap-fill",
        "historicalSimilarity": "DOC-3137 (100% domain overlap — continuation of same task scope)"
    },
    "patterns": patterns,
    "antiPatterns": anti_patterns,
    "domainInsights": domain_insights,
    "sourceObservations": source_observations,
    "styleEvolutions": style_evolutions,
    "taskRetroLessons": task_retro_lessons,
    "staleEntries": stale_entries,
    "conflicts": conflicts,
    "summary": {
        "patternsIncluded": len(patterns),
        "antiPatternsIncluded": len(anti_patterns),
        "domainInsightsIncluded": len(domain_insights),
        "sourceObservationsIncluded": len(source_observations),
        "styleEvolutionsIncluded": len(style_evolutions),
        "taskRetroLessonsIncluded": len(task_retro_lessons),
        "staleEntriesFlagged": len(stale_entries),
        "conflictsDetected": len(conflicts),
        "totalIndexEntries": total_entries,
        "relevanceThreshold": threshold,
        "truncated": truncated,
        "truncatedFrom": len([s for s, e in scored if s >= threshold]) + (len(included) if truncated else 0) if not truncated else len([s for s, e in scored if s >= threshold]),
        "coldStart": False
    }
}

# Fix truncatedFrom: count total above threshold from original scored list
all_above = [(s, e) for s, e in scored if s >= threshold]
if truncated:
    brief["summary"]["truncatedFrom"] = len(all_above)
else:
    del brief["summary"]["truncatedFrom"]

with open("/workspace/.docwriter/knowledge-brief.json", "w") as f:
    json.dump(brief, f, indent=2)

print(f"Brief written: {len(patterns)} patterns, {len(anti_patterns)} anti-patterns, {len(domain_insights)} domain insights, {len(source_observations)} source observations, {len(style_evolutions)} style evolutions, {len(task_retro_lessons)} task retro lessons")
print(f"Truncated: {truncated} (from {len(all_above)} entries above threshold)")
print(f"Stale entries: {len(stale_entries)}")
print(f"Conflicts: {len(conflicts)}")

### Key Findings

**Diff-analyzer** (gap-fill mode) identified 9 product areas covering the full ContentRetriever API surface:
- **Core**: `IContentRetriever` interface with 8 Retrieve methods
- **IncludeUrlPath**: Property on `RetrieveParametersBase<T>` (default `true`) — controls whether URL JOINs happen
- **UrlPathColumns()**: Fluent method to add URL columns when `Columns()` limits the query
- **Extension methods**: Simplified overloads developers actually call (3 per method)
- **ByGuids**: GUID-based retrieval methods
- **API Examples**: `ContentItems.cs` and `Pages.cs` — currently use positional params, need named params
- **URL Path Infrastructure**: Lower-level CIQ extensions (`ForWebsite`, `WithWebPageData`)

**Corpus-scanner** indexed the full documentation workspace with 65 topic clusters and 5,390 internal links. The 4 primary target pages are:
1. `content-retriever-api.md` — conceptual guide

3. `content-item-query-api.md` — CIQ guide

namespace Kentico.Content.Web.Mvc
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Base class for query parameters used during retrieval.
    /// <seealso cref="IContentRetriever" />
    /// </summary>
    public abstract class RetrieveQueryParametersBase<T>
        where T : RetrieveQueryParametersBase<T>
    {
        private bool idColumnIncluded = false;


        private readonly int linkedItemsMaxLevel;


        /// <summary>
        /// Content query actions to be applied to the query parameters.
        /// </summary>
        protected List<Action<ContentQueryParameters>> ContentQueryActions { get; init; }


        /// <summary>
        /// Content type query actions to be applied to the query parameters.
        /// </summary>
        protected List<Action<ContentTypesQueryParameters>> ContentTypesQueryActions { get; init; }


        /// <summary>
        /// Initializes a new instance of <see cref="RetrieveQueryParametersBase{T}"/>.
        /// </summary>
        /// <param name="linkedItemsMaxLevel">The maximum level of linked items that will be included if <see cref="WithLinkedItems(Action{LinkedItemsOptions})"/> is called.</param>
        internal RetrieveQueryParametersBase(int linkedItemsMaxLevel)
        {
            this.linkedItemsMaxLevel = linkedItemsMaxLevel;
            ContentQueryActions = [];
            ContentTypesQueryActions = [];
        }


        /// <summary>
        /// Returns default empty configuration action of <typeparamref name="T"/>.
        /// </summary>
        public static Action<T> Default => null;


        /// <summary>
        /// Configures the columns to be selected.
        /// </summary>
        /// <param name="columnNames">Names of columns to be selected.</param>
        /// <returns>Returns <typeparamref name="T"/> instance to chain further configuration.</returns>
        public T Columns(params string[] columnNames)
        {
            EnsureRequiredColumns();
            ContentQueryActions.Add(p => p.Columns(columnNames));
            return (T)this;
        }


        /// <summary>
        /// Configures the columns to be selected.
        /// </summary>
        /// <param name="columns">Columns to be selected represented as <see cref="QueryColumn"/>.</param>
        /// <returns>Returns <typeparamref name="T"/> instance to chain further configuration.</returns>
        public T Columns(params QueryColumn[] columns)
        {
            EnsureRequiredColumns();
            ContentQueryActions.Add(p => p.Columns(columns));
            return (T)this;
        }


        /// <summary>
        /// Configures query to include linked content items recursively up to the specified <see cref="RetrieveParametersBase{T}.LinkedItemsMaxLevel"/>.
        /// </summary>
        /// <param name="configureOptionsAction">Action to configure specific options for linked items. See <see cref="LinkedItemsOptions"/> for possible options.</param>

        /// Use the <see cref="IContentQueryDataContainer.GetLinkedItems(string)"/> method during result mapping (<see cref="IContentQueryExecutor.GetResult{TModel}(ContentItemQueryBuilder, Func{IContentQueryDataContainer, TModel}, ContentQueryExecutionOptions, System.Threading.CancellationToken)"/>
        /// to access the linked content items of an item.
        /// </para>
        /// <para>
        /// By default <see cref="ContentRetriever"/> includes web page data for linked items.
        /// <seealso cref="LinkedItemsOptions.IncludeWebPageData(bool)"/>
        /// </para>
        /// </remarks>
        public T WithLinkedItems(Action<LinkedItemsOptions> configureOptionsAction)
        {
            ContentTypesQueryActions.Add(p => p.WithLinkedItems(linkedItemsMaxLevel, configureOptionsAction));
            return (T)this;
        }

        /// Defines the behavior for URL paths of web pages in fallback languages.
        /// </summary>
        /// <returns>Returns <typeparamref name="T"/> instance to chain further configuration.</returns>
        /// <remarks>By default behavior is set to <see cref="UrlLanguageBehavior.UseRequestedLanguage"/> in <see cref="ContentRetriever"/></remarks>
        /// <param name="urlLanguageBehavior">URL language behavior.</param>

        {
            ContentTypesQueryActions.Add(p => p.SetUrlLanguageBehavior(urlLanguageBehavior));
            return (T)this;
        }


        /// <summary>
        /// Applies content query configuration stored in this object to <paramref name="parameters"/>.
        /// </summary>
        /// <param name="parameters">The <see cref="ContentQueryParameters"/> to which apply the configuration.</param>
        internal void ApplyContentQueryActions(ContentQueryParameters parameters)
        {
            foreach (var action in ContentQueryActions)
            {
                action.Invoke(parameters);
            }
        }


        /// <summary>
        /// Applies content types query configuration stored in this object to <paramref name="parameters"/>.
        /// </summary>
        /// <param name="parameters">The <see cref="ContentTypesQueryParameters"/> to which apply the configuration.</param>
        internal void ApplyContentTypesQueryActions(ContentTypesQueryParameters parameters)
        {
            foreach (var action in ContentTypesQueryActions)
            {
                action.Invoke(parameters);
            }
        }


        /// <summary>
        /// Ensures that all required columns are present in the resulting query.
        /// </summary>
        private protected void EnsureRequiredColumns()
        {
            if (!idColumnIncluded)
            {
                ContentQueryActions.Add(p => p.Columns(ContentRetrieverConstants.REQUIRED_COLUMNS));
                idColumnIncluded = true;
            }
        }
    }

        private CurrentPageWebsiteContext GetMergedCurrentPageWebsiteContext(RetrieveCurrentPageParameters parameters)
        {
            try
            {
                var websiteContext = websiteContextProvider.GetCurrentPageWebsiteContext();

                if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(parameters.LanguageName))
                {
                    websiteContext.LanguageName = parameters.LanguageName;
                }
                if (parameters.IsForPreview.HasValue)
                {
                    websiteContext.IsForPreview = parameters.IsForPreview.Value;
                }

                return websiteContext;
            }
            catch (InvalidOperationException exception)
            {
                throw new InvalidOperationException("Website data context could not be retrieved.", exception);
            }
        }


        private PagesWebsiteContext GetMergedPagesWebsiteContext<T>(RetrievePagesParametersBase<T> parameters)
            where T : RetrievePagesParametersBase<T>, new()
        {
            try
            {
                var websiteContext = websiteContextProvider.GetPagesWebsiteContext();

                if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(parameters.LanguageName))
                {
                    websiteContext.LanguageName = parameters.LanguageName;
                }
                if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(parameters.ChannelName))
                {
                    websiteContext.ChannelName = parameters.ChannelName;
                }
                if (parameters.IsForPreview.HasValue)
                {
                    websiteContext.IsForPreview = parameters.IsForPreview.Value;
                }

                return websiteContext;
            }
            catch (InvalidOperationException exception)
            {
                if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(parameters.LanguageName)
                    || string.IsNullOrEmpty(parameters.ChannelName)
                    || !parameters.IsForPreview.HasValue)
                {
                    throw new InvalidOperationException(
                        $"Website data context could not be retrieved. " +
                        $"Parameters {nameof(parameters.ChannelName)}, {nameof(parameters.LanguageName)}, and {nameof(parameters.IsForPreview)} need to be specified manually.",
                        exception);
                }

                return new PagesWebsiteContext()
                {
                    LanguageName = parameters.LanguageName,
                    ChannelName = parameters.ChannelName,
                    IsForPreview = parameters.IsForPreview.Value
                };
            }
        }

        private async Task<IEnumerable<TResult>> ExecuteQuery<TSource, TResult>(
            ContentItemQueryBuilder builder,
            ContentQueryExecutionOptions options,
            int linkedItemsMaxLevel,
            Func<IContentQueryDataContainer, TSource, Task<TResult>> configureModel,
            RetrievalCacheSettings cacheSettings,
            string cacheItemName,
            CacheDependencyBuilder cacheDependencyBuilder,
            CancellationToken cancellationToken)
        {
            var executionCacheSettings = new CacheSettings(
                GetCacheExpiration(cacheSettings),
                cacheSettings.UseSlidingExpiration,
                cacheItemName);

            if (cacheSettings.AdditionalCacheDependencies is not null)
            {
                cacheDependencyBuilder = cacheDependencyBuilder
                    .AddDependency(cacheSettings.AdditionalCacheDependencies);
            }

            if (configureModel is null)
            {
                var resultsAndContainers = await ExecuteQueryInternal<TResult>(builder, options, linkedItemsMaxLevel, cacheSettings,
                    cacheDependencyBuilder, executionCacheSettings, cancellationToken);

                return resultsAndContainers.Select(x => x.Result);
            }

            var sourcesAndContainers = await ExecuteQueryInternal<TSource>(builder, options, linkedItemsMaxLevel, cacheSettings,
                    cacheDependencyBuilder, executionCacheSettings, cancellationToken);

            return await ConfigureResultsFromSources(configureModel, sourcesAndContainers);
        }


        private async Task<IEnumerable<(TResult Result, IContentQueryDataContainer Container)>> ExecuteQueryInternal<TResult>(
            ContentItemQueryBuilder builder,
            ContentQueryExecutionOptions options,
            int linkedItemsMaxLevel,
            RetrievalCacheSettings cacheSettings,
            CacheDependencyBuilder cacheDependencyBuilder,
            CacheSettings executionCacheSettings,
            CancellationToken cancellationToken)
        {
            IEnumerable<(TResult Result, IContentQueryDataContainer Container)> resultsAndContainers;

            if (cacheSettings.DisableCaching || options.ForPreview)
            {
                resultsAndContainers = await executor.GetResult(builder, GetResultWithContainer<TResult>, options, cancellationToken);

                {

                    await SetCacheDependencies(resultsAndContainers, linkedItemsMaxLevel, cacheDependencyBuilder, ct, cs);

                    return resultsAndContainers;
                }, executionCacheSettings, cancellationToken);
            }

            return resultsAndContainers;
        }

private async Task SetCacheDependencies<TResult>(
            IEnumerable<(TResult Result, IContentQueryDataContainer Container)> resultsAndContainers,
            int linkedItemsMaxLevel,
            CacheDependencyBuilder cacheDependencyBuilder,
            CancellationToken cancellationToken,
            CacheSettings cacheSettings = null)
        {
            var ids = resultsAndContainers
                .Select(x => x.Container.ContentItemID)
                .ToList();

            cacheDependencyBuilder
                .ForContentItems()
                    .ById(ids)
                    .Builder();
            if (linkedItemsMaxLevel > 0)
            {
                cacheDependencyBuilder
                    .AddDependency(await linkedItemsDependencyRetriever.Get(ids, linkedItemsMaxLevel, cancellationToken));
            }
            var dependency = cacheDependencyBuilder.Build();

            if (cacheSettings is not null)
            {
                cacheSettings.CacheDependency = dependency;
            }

            // Wrapping in this scope so the collector does not throw when it has not been created yet.
            using (var cacheDependencyCollector = new CacheDependencyCollector())
            {
                CacheDependencyCollector.AddCacheDependency(dependency);
            }
        }


        private double GetCacheExpiration(RetrievalCacheSettings cacheSettings)
        {
            return cacheSettings.UseDefaultCacheExpiration
                ? cacheOptions.Value.DefaultCacheExpiration.TotalMinutes
                : cacheSettings.CacheExpiration.TotalMinutes;
        }


        private static string GetCacheItemName<TParams, TResult>(RetrieveParametersBase<TParams> parameters, ContentItemsWebsiteContext context, params object[] cacheItemNameParts)
            where TParams : RetrieveParametersBase<TParams>, new()
        {
            return CacheHelper.GetCacheItemName(null, [
                parameters.UseLanguageFallbacks,
                parameters.LinkedItemsMaxLevel,
                parameters.IncludeSecuredItems,
                context.IsForPreview,
                context.LanguageName,
                typeof(TResult).Name,
                .. cacheItemNameParts]);
        }


        private static async Task<List<TResult>> ConfigureResultsFromSources<TSource, TResult>(
            Func<IContentQueryDataContainer, TSource, Task<TResult>> configureModel,
            IEnumerable<(TSource Result, IContentQueryDataContainer Container)> sourcesAndContainers)
        {
            var results = new List<TResult>();
            foreach (var (source, container) in sourcesAndContainers)
            {
                results.Add(await configureModel(container, source));
            }

            return results;
        }


        private (TResult Result, IContentQueryDataContainer Container) GetResultWithContainer<TResult>(IContentQueryDataContainer container)
        {
            var result = mapper.Map<TResult>(container);

            return (result, container);
        }


        private CacheDependencyBuilder GetCacheBuilderWithContentTypeDependencies(IEnumerable<string> contentTypes)
        {
            var cacheDependencyBuilder = cacheDependencyBuilderFactory.Create();

            if (contentTypes is null || !contentTypes.Any())
            {
                return cacheDependencyBuilder;
            }

            var reusableSchemas = contentTypes.SelectMany(ct => reusableFieldSchemaManager.GetSchemasForContentType(ct))
                .Select(x => x.Name)
                .Distinct();

            return cacheDependencyBuilder
                .ForInfoObjects<ContentTypeInfo>()
                    .ByCodeName(contentTypes)
                    .Builder()
                .ForReusableFieldSchemas()
                    .ByName(reusableSchemas)
                    .Builder();
        }


        private CacheDependencyBuilder GetCacheBuilderWithReusableSchemaDependencies(IEnumerable<string> reusableSchemas)
        {
            var cacheDependencyBuilder = cacheDependencyBuilderFactory.Create();

            if (reusableSchemas is null || !reusableSchemas.Any())
            {
                return cacheDependencyBuilder;
            }

            var schemaGuids = reusableSchemas.Select(schema => reusableFieldSchemaManager.Get(schema).Guid);
            var contentTypes = reusableFieldSchemaManager.GetContentTypesWithSchema([.. schemaGuids])
                .Distinct();

            return cacheDependencyBuilder
                .ForInfoObjects<ContentTypeInfo>()
                    .ByCodeName(contentTypes)
                    .Builder()
                .ForReusableFieldSchemas()
                    .ByName(reusableSchemas)
                    .Builder();
        }
    }
}

        /// <summary>
        /// Retrieves content items of content types specified by <paramref name="contentTypeNames"/> and GUIDs.
        /// </summary>
        /// <typeparam name="TResult">Model of the final retrieved results.</typeparam>
        /// <param name="contentRetriever">Content retriever.</param>
        /// <param name="contentTypeNames">Names of the content types defining retrieved results.</param>
        /// <param name="contentItemGuids">GUID identifiers of content items.</param>
        /// <param name="parameters">Parameters used to modify retrieval.</param>
        /// <param name="additionalQueryConfiguration">Action to additionally modify query during retrieval.</param>
        /// <param name="cacheSettings">Cache setting used to modify caching during retrieval.</param>
        /// <param name="cancellationToken">Cancellation token.</param>
        public static Task<IEnumerable<TResult>> RetrieveContentOfContentTypesByGuids<TResult>(
            this IContentRetriever contentRetriever,
            IEnumerable<string> contentTypeNames,
            IEnumerable<Guid> contentItemGuids,
            RetrieveContentOfContentTypesParameters parameters,
            Action<RetrieveContentOfContentTypesQueryParameters> additionalQueryConfiguration,
            RetrievalCacheSettings cacheSettings,
            CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
        {
            return RetrieveContentOfContentTypesByGuids<TResult>(contentRetriever, contentTypeNames, contentItemGuids, parameters, additionalQueryConfiguration, cacheSettings, null, cancellationToken);
        }


        /// <summary>
        /// Retrieves content items of content types specified by <paramref name="contentTypeNames"/> and GUIDs.
        /// </summary>
        /// <typeparam name="TResult">Model of the final retrieved results.</typeparam>
        /// <param name="contentRetriever">Content retriever.</param>
        /// <param name="contentTypeNames">Names of the content types defining retrieved results.</param>
        /// <param name="contentItemGuids">GUID identifiers of content items.</param>
        /// <param name="parameters">Parameters used to modify retrieval.</param>
        /// <param name="additionalQueryConfiguration">Action to additionally modify query during retrieval.</param>
        /// <param name="cacheSettings">Cache setting used to modify caching during retrieval.</param>
        /// <param name="configureModel">Function providing additional configuration for the resulting <typeparamref name="TResult"/> instance based on content query data container.</param>
        /// <param name="cancellationToken">Cancellation token.</param>
        public static Task<IEnumerable<TResult>> RetrieveContentOfContentTypesByGuids<TResult>(
            this IContentRetriever contentRetriever,
            IEnumerable<string> contentTypeNames,
            IEnumerable<Guid> contentItemGuids,
            RetrieveContentOfContentTypesParameters parameters,
            Action<RetrieveContentOfContentTypesQueryParameters> additionalQueryConfiguration,
            RetrievalCacheSettings cacheSettings,
            Func<IContentQueryDataContainer, TResult, Task<TResult>> configureModel,
            CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
        {
            ArgumentNullException.ThrowIfNull(contentItemGuids);
            ArgumentNullException.ThrowIfNull(cacheSettings);

            var contentRetrieverWithProvider = RetrieveByGuidsBaseExtensions.GetAndValidateRetriever(contentRetriever);

            var cacheDependencyBuilder = contentRetrieverWithProvider.ServiceProvider.GetRequiredService<ICacheDependencyBuilderFactory>()
                .Create()
                .ForContentItems()
                    .ByGuid(contentItemGuids)
                    .Builder();

            var retrievalCacheSettings = RetrieveByGuidsBaseExtensions.GetRetrievalCacheSettings(cacheDependencyBuilder, cacheSettings, contentItemGuids);

            return contentRetriever.RetrieveContentOfContentTypes<TResult>(contentTypeNames, parameters,
                config =>
                {
                    config.Where(where => where.WhereIn(nameof(IContentItemFieldsSource.SystemFields.ContentItemGUID), contentItemGuids));
                    additionalQueryConfiguration?.Invoke(config);
                },
                retrievalCacheSettings, configureModel, cancellationToken);
        }
    }
}

using System;
using System.Diagnostics.CodeAnalysis;

using CMS.Core.Internal;
using CMS.Helpers;

namespace Kentico.Content.Web.Mvc
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Cache settings for used for content retrieval.
    /// <seealso cref="IContentRetriever" />
    /// </summary>
    public sealed class RetrievalCacheSettings
    {
        private RetrievalCacheSettings()
        {
            DisableCaching = true;
        }


        internal RetrievalCacheSettings(
            string cacheItemNameSuffix,
            TimeSpan cacheExpiration,
            bool cacheOnlyResultingItems,
            bool useSlidingExpiration,
            CMSCacheDependency additionalCacheDependencies,
            bool useDefaultCacheExpiration,
            bool allowEmptyCacheItemNameSuffix = false)
        {
            if (!allowEmptyCacheItemNameSuffix && string.IsNullOrEmpty(cacheItemNameSuffix))
            {
                throw new ArgumentException("Cache item name suffix cannot be null or empty.", nameof(cacheItemNameSuffix));
            }

            DisableCaching = false;
            CacheItemNameSuffix = cacheItemNameSuffix;
            CacheExpiration = cacheExpiration;
            CacheOnlyResultingItems = cacheOnlyResultingItems;
            UseSlidingExpiration = useSlidingExpiration;
            AdditionalCacheDependencies = additionalCacheDependencies;
            UseDefaultCacheExpiration = useDefaultCacheExpiration;
        }


        /// <summary>
        /// Initializes a new instance of <see cref="RetrievalCacheSettings"/>.
        /// </summary>
        /// <param name="cacheItemNameSuffix">Cache item name suffix. This suffix should reflect all additional query configurations used.</param>
        /// <param name="cacheExpiration">Cache expiration.</param>
        /// <param name="cacheOnlyResultingItems">Specifies if only resulting items should be cached.</param>
        /// <param name="useSlidingExpiration">Specifies if sliding expiration should be used.</param>
        /// <param name="additionalCacheDependencies">Additional cache dependencies.</param>
        public RetrievalCacheSettings(
            string cacheItemNameSuffix,
            TimeSpan cacheExpiration,
            bool cacheOnlyResultingItems = false,
            bool useSlidingExpiration = false,
            CMSCacheDependency additionalCacheDependencies = null
            ) : this(
                cacheItemNameSuffix,
                cacheExpiration,
                 cacheOnlyResultingItems,
                 useSlidingExpiration,
                additionalCacheDependencies,
                false)
        {
        }


        /// <summary>
        /// Initializes a new instance of <see cref="RetrievalCacheSettings"/> with default cache expiration.
        /// <seealso cref="ContentRetrieverCacheOptions"/>
        /// </summary>
        /// <param name="cacheItemNameSuffix">Cache item name suffix. This suffix should reflect all additional query configurations used.</param>
        /// <param name="cacheOnlyResultingItems">Specifies if only resulting items should be cached.</param>
        /// <param name="useSlidingExpiration">Specifies if sliding expiration should be used.</param>
        /// <param name="additionalCacheDependencies">Additional cache dependencies.</param>
        public RetrievalCacheSettings(
            string cacheItemNameSuffix,
            bool cacheOnlyResultingItems = false,
            bool useSlidingExpiration = false,
            CMSCacheDependency additionalCacheDependencies = null
            ) : this(
                cacheItemNameSuffix,
                TimeSpan.Zero,
                cacheOnlyResultingItems,
                useSlidingExpiration,
                additionalCacheDependencies,
                true)
        {
        }


        /// <summary>
        /// Initializes new <see cref="RetrievalCacheSettings"/> with caching disabled.
        /// </summary>        
        public static RetrievalCacheSettings CacheDisabled => new();


        /// <summary>
        /// Initializes new <see cref="RetrievalCacheSettings"/> with default cache settings.
        /// </summary>        
        internal static RetrievalCacheSettings Default => new(null,
            TimeSpan.Zero,
            false,
            false,
            null,
            true,
            true);


        /// <summary>
        /// Specifies if the caching during retrieval should be disabled. 
        /// If <c>true</c>, other properties do not have any effect.
        /// </summary>
        internal bool DisableCaching { get; init; }


        /// <summary>
        /// Indicates whether sliding expiration should be used. 
        /// If enabled, objects are removed from the cache only if they are not accessed for the number of minutes specified by <see cref="CacheExpiration"/>.
        /// </summary>
        internal bool UseSlidingExpiration { get; }


        /// <summary>
        /// Specifies if only resulting models from the retrieval should be cached. 
        /// This removes broad dependencies like 'by content type' or 'all'.
        /// </summary>
        internal bool CacheOnlyResultingItems { get; set; }


        /// <summary>
        /// Cache expiration time span.
        /// </summary>
        internal TimeSpan CacheExpiration { get; }


        /// <summary>
        /// Cache item name suffix. 
        /// This suffix is used to create cache key for the cached items.
        /// </summary>
        internal string CacheItemNameSuffix { get; }


        /// <summary>
        /// Additional cache dependencies. 
        /// This dependency is used to invalidate the cache when the dependency changes.
        /// </summary>
        internal CMSCacheDependency AdditionalCacheDependencies { get; set; }


        internal bool UseDefaultCacheExpiration { get; }
    }
}

    public static class ContentQueryParametersUrlExtensions
    {
        /// <summary>
        /// Configures URL path columns to be selected.
        /// </summary>

        /// <remarks>
        /// The method is used to further parametrize the content query by configuring required columns
        /// (<see cref="WebPageFields.WebPageItemID"/>, <see cref="WebPageFields.WebPageItemTreePath"/>, <see cref="WebPageFields.WebPageUrlPath"/>,

        /// </remarks>
        public static ContentQueryParameters UrlPathColumns(this ContentQueryParameters parameters)
        {
            return parameters.Columns(WebPageUrlContants.UrlPathColumns);

namespace CMS.Websites
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Retrieves URLs of web pages.
    /// </summary>
    public interface IWebPageUrlRetriever
    {
        /// <summary>
        /// Retrieves URL for a web page represented by a model that implements <see cref="IWebPageFieldsSource"/> interface.
        /// </summary>
        /// <param name="webPageFieldsSource">Web page model that implements <see cref="IWebPageFieldsSource"/> with data retrieved from the database.</param>
        /// <param name="cancellationToken">Cancellation instruction.</param>
        /// <exception cref="ArgumentNullException">Thrown when <paramref name="webPageFieldsSource"/> is null.</exception>
        /// <exception cref="ArgumentException">Thrown when <see cref="IWebPageFieldsSource.SystemFields"/> in <paramref name="webPageFieldsSource"/> is null.</exception>
        /// <exception cref="InvalidOperationException">
        /// Thrown when <paramref name="webPageFieldsSource"/> model does not contain web page identifier or content language identifier specified in <see cref="IWebPageFieldsSource.SystemFields"/> system data.
        /// Thrown when web page identified by <see cref="WebPageFields.WebPageItemID"/> in <see cref="IWebPageFieldsSource.SystemFields"/> does not exist.
        /// </exception>
        /// <remarks>
        /// <para>
        /// To construct the resulting URL use <see cref="ContentTypeQueryParametersExtensions.ForWebsite(ContentEngine.ContentTypeQueryParameters, string, PathMatch, bool)"/> or <see cref="ContentTypeQueryParametersExtensions.ForWebsite(ContentEngine.ContentTypeQueryParameters, string, PathMatch[], bool)"/>
        /// with 'includeUrlPath' flag set to <c>true</c>.
        /// </para>
        /// In case of limiting the columns in the query use <see cref="ContentTypeQueryParametersUrlExtensions.UrlPathColumns(ContentEngine.ContentTypeQueryParameters)"/>
        /// to add all required columns to construct the URL.
        /// </remarks>
        Task<WebPageUrl> Retrieve(IWebPageFieldsSource webPageFieldsSource, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default);


        /// <summary>
        /// Retrieves URL for a web page represented by a model that implements <see cref="IWebPageFieldsSource"/> interface and for the <paramref name="languageName"/>.
        /// </summary>
        /// <param name="webPageFieldsSource">Web page model that implements <see cref="IWebPageFieldsSource"/> with data retrieved from the database.</param>
        /// <param name="languageName">Language code.</param>
        /// <param name="cancellationToken">Cancellation instruction.</param>
        /// <exception cref="ArgumentNullException">Thrown when <paramref name="webPageFieldsSource"/> is null.</exception>
        /// <exception cref="ArgumentException">Thrown when <see cref="IWebPageFieldsSource.SystemFields"/> in <paramref name="webPageFieldsSource"/> is null.</exception>
        /// <exception cref="InvalidOperationException">
        /// Thrown when <paramref name="webPageFieldsSource"/> model does not contain web page identifier specified in <see cref="IWebPageFieldsSource.SystemFields"/> system data.
        /// Thrown when content language identified by <paramref name="languageName"/> does not exist.
        /// Thrown when web page identified by <see cref="WebPageFields.WebPageItemID"/> in <see cref="IWebPageFieldsSource.SystemFields"/> does not exist.
        /// </exception>
        /// <remarks>
        /// In case the <paramref name="languageName"/> doesn't match the language of the model, the URL is retrieved from the database for the <paramref name="languageName"/>.
        /// <para>
        /// To construct the resulting URL use <see cref="ContentTypeQueryParametersExtensions.ForWebsite(ContentEngine.ContentTypeQueryParameters, string, PathMatch, bool)"/> or <see cref="ContentTypeQueryParametersExtensions.ForWebsite(ContentEngine.ContentTypeQueryParameters, string, PathMatch[], bool)"/>
        /// with 'includeUrlPath' flag set to <c>true</c>.
        /// </para>
        /// In case of limiting the columns in the query use <see cref="ContentTypeQueryParametersUrlExtensions.UrlPathColumns(ContentEngine.ContentTypeQueryParameters)"/>
        /// to add all required columns to construct the URL.
        /// </remarks>
        Task<WebPageUrl> Retrieve(IWebPageFieldsSource webPageFieldsSource, string languageName, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default);

        /// </summary>
        /// <param name="webPageUrlPath">Web page URL path.</param>
        /// <param name="webPageTreePath">Web page tree path.</param>
        /// <param name="websiteChannelId">Website channel identifier.</param>
        /// <param name="languageName">Language code.</param>
        /// <param name="cancellationToken">Cancellation instruction.</param>
        /// <exception cref="InvalidOperationException">
        /// Thrown when <paramref name="webPageTreePath"/> is null or empty.
        /// Thrown when website channel identified by <paramref name="websiteChannelId"/> does not exist.
        /// Thrown when content language identified by <paramref name="languageName"/> does not exist.
        /// </exception>
        /// <exception cref="ArgumentNullException">Thrown when <paramref name="languageName"/> is null.</exception>
        /// <remarks>
        /// <para>
        /// To construct the resulting URL use <see cref="ContentTypeQueryParametersExtensions.ForWebsite(ContentEngine.ContentTypeQueryParameters, string, PathMatch, bool)"/> or <see cref="ContentTypeQueryParametersExtensions.ForWebsite(ContentEngine.ContentTypeQueryParameters, string, PathMatch[], bool)"/>
        /// with 'includeUrlPath' flag set to <c>true</c>.
        /// </para>
        /// Use <see cref="ContentTypeQueryParametersUrlExtensions.UrlPathColumns(ContentEngine.ContentTypeQueryParameters)"/> to add all required columns to the query to construct the URL.
        /// </remarks>
        Task<WebPageUrl> Retrieve(string webPageUrlPath, string webPageTreePath, int websiteChannelId, string languageName, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default);


        /// <summary>
        /// Retrieves the URL for a web page language variant identified by <paramref name="webPageItemId"/> and <paramref name="languageName"/>.

        /// <exception cref="ArgumentNullException">Thrown when <paramref name="languageName"/> is null.</exception>
        /// <exception cref="InvalidOperationException">
        /// Thrown when web page identified by <paramref name="webPageItemId"/> or when content language identified by <paramref name="languageName"/> does not exists.
        /// </exception>
        /// <remarks>The method caches the retrieved URL unless retrieving the latest version of the URL for preview.</remarks>
        Task<WebPageUrl> Retrieve(int webPageItemId, string languageName, bool forPreview = false, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default);

        Task<WebPageUrl> Retrieve(Guid webPageItemGuid, string languageName, bool forPreview = false, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default);


        /// <summary>
        /// Retrieves the URLs for a web page language variants identified by <paramref name="webPageItemGuids"/>, <paramref name="websiteChannelName"/> and <paramref name="languageName"/>.

        /// <param name="websiteChannelName">Website channel name.</param>
        /// <param name="languageName">Language code.</param>
        /// <param name="forPreview">Indicates whether the latest version of the URL should be retrieved. The default value is <c>false</c>.</param>
        /// <param name="cancellationToken">Cancellation instruction.</param>

        /// <summary>
        /// Retrieves the URL for a web page language variant identified by <paramref name="webPageTreePath"/>, <paramref name="websiteChannelName"/> and <paramref name="languageName"/>.

            /// <heading>Retrieve content items in web applications</heading>
            private async void RetrieveContentItemsInWebsites()
            {
                /* IContentRetriever is a service class that provides a high-level abstraction over the Content item query API for retrieving content.
                 * The service is intended for content retrieval in the context of Xperience web applications.
                 * 
                 * The service ensures the following default behavior for each query:
                 *  -- Determines whether to retrieve the latest or published versions based on the current request context
                 *  -- Retrieves content in the language matching the current request context
                 *  -- Takes into account language fallback settings for content that does not exist in the specific language
                 *  -- Provides built-in caching with automatic cache dependency collection
                 *
                 * You can further parameterize the queries using parameter objects and query configuration delegates.
                 * 
                 * See the 'Reference - ContentRetriever API' documentation for a comprehensive overview of the API.
                 * For a quick reference, see the following code examples:
                 */

                // Retrieves content items of a single content type
                IEnumerable<CandyStore> candyStores = await contentRetriever.RetrieveContent<CandyStore>();

                // Retrieves content items from a specified workspace in a specific language
                IEnumerable<CandyStore> workspaceStores = await contentRetriever.RetrieveContent<CandyStore>(
                    new RetrieveContentParameters
                    {
                        WorkspaceNames = new[] { "MainContent" },
                        LanguageName = "en"
                    });

                // Retrieves content items of multiple content types using a shared interface
                var contentTypes = new[] { CandyStore.CONTENT_TYPE_NAME, Author.CONTENT_TYPE_NAME };
                IEnumerable<IContentItemFieldsSource> mixedContent =
                    await contentRetriever.RetrieveContentOfContentTypes<IContentItemFieldsSource>(contentTypes);

                // Retrieves specific content items by their GUIDs
                var contentItemGuids = new[] { Guid.Parse("c6f453db-dd39-46ac-bdb1-78bdb5b20a9e") };
                IEnumerable<CandyStore> specificContent =
                    await contentRetriever.RetrieveContentByGuids<CandyStore>(contentItemGuids);

                // Retrieves content items that implement specific reusable field schemas
                var schemaNames = new[] { "ProductFields", "MetadataSchema" };

            /// <heading>Retrieve pages in web applications</heading>
            private async void RetrievePagesInWebsites()
            {
                /* IContentRetriever is a service class that provides a high-level abstraction over the Content item query API for retrieving content.
                 * The service is intended for content retrieval in the context of Xperience web applications.
                 *
                 * The service ensures the following default behavior for each query:
                 *  -- Uses the current website channel context to determine the website channel for which the content is retrieved
                 *  -- Determines whether to retrieve the latest or published versions based on the current request context
                 *  -- Retrieves content in the language matching the current request context
                 *  -- Takes into account language fallback settings for content that does not exist in the specific language
                 *  -- Provides built-in caching with automatic cache dependency collection
                 *
                 * You can further parameterize the queries using parameter objects and query configuration delegates.
                 *
                 * See the 'Reference - ContentRetriever API' documentation for a comprehensive overview of the API.
                 * For a quick reference, see the following code examples:
                 */

                // Retrieves the current page from the current site, in the language of the current request
                CandyStorePage currentPage = await contentRetriever.RetrieveCurrentPage<CandyStorePage>();

                // Retrieves multiple pages of the same type from a specific path with linked items
                IEnumerable<CandyStorePage> storePages = await contentRetriever.RetrievePages<CandyStorePage>(
                    new RetrievePagesParameters
                    {
                        PathMatch = PathMatch.Children("/Locations"),
                        LinkedItemsMaxLevel = 1
                    });

                // Retrieves pages of different content types using a shared interface
                var contentTypes = new[] { CandyStorePage.CONTENT_TYPE_NAME, ChocolateReviewPage.CONTENT_TYPE_NAME };
                IEnumerable<IWebPageFieldsSource> mixedPages = await contentRetriever.RetrievePagesOfContentTypes<IWebPageFieldsSource>(contentTypes);

                // Retrieves specific pages by their GUIDs
                var pageGuids = new[] { Guid.Parse("c4b1f72e-42d7-41dd-8130-00cd118f5f20") };
                IEnumerable<CandyStorePage> specificPages = await contentRetriever.RetrievePagesByGuids<CandyStorePage>(pageGuids);

                // Retrieves pages that use specific reusable field schemas
                // Assuming 'IPageMetadata' is an interface implemented by types using these schemas
                var schemaNames = new[] { "MetadataSchema", "SeoSchema" };
                IEnumerable<IPageMetadata> pagesWithSchemas = await contentRetriever.RetrievePagesOfReusableSchemas<IPageMetadata>(schemaNames);

                // Retrieves all pages from a specific channel
                IEnumerable<IWebPageFieldsSource> channelPages = await contentRetriever.RetrieveAllPages<IWebPageFieldsSource>(
                    new RetrieveAllPagesParameters
                    {
                        ChannelName = "WonkaPages"
                    });

                // Retrieves all pages (of any content type) by their WebPageItemGUIDs

                // Combined content selectors return ContentItemGUID

            /// <heading>Retrieve pages of a single content type</heading>
            private async void RetrieveContentItemsOfContentType()
            {
                // This example demonstrates how to retrieve pages of a single content type
                string STORE_CONTENT_TYPE = "Wonka.CandyStorePage";
                string languageName = "en";
                int maxLevel = 1;

                // Gets top 5 rated website channel pages of 'Wonka.CandyStorePage' content type and their linked content items
                ContentItemQueryBuilder builder =
                        new ContentItemQueryBuilder()
                                .ForContentType(STORE_CONTENT_TYPE, subqueryParameters =>
                                {
                                    subqueryParameters.ForWebsite(
                                        websiteChannelName: "WonkaPages",
                                        pathMatch: PathMatch.Children("/Locations"))
                                    .TopN(5)
                                    .WithLinkedItems(maxLevel);
                                    // Optional methods for global parametrization of their preceding queries
                                }).InLanguage(languageName)
                                  .Parameters(subqueryParameters =>
                                   subqueryParameters.OrderBy(new OrderByColumn("StoreRating", OrderDirection.Descending)));

                // Executes the query specified in 'builder' and binds it to the CandyStorePage class generated for the CandyStorePage content type
                IEnumerable<CandyStorePage> candyStorePages =
                        await contentQueryExecutor.GetMappedResult<CandyStorePage>(builder);
            }


            /// <heading>Retrieve parent page of known content type</heading>
            private async void RetrieveParentPageKnownType()
            {
                // This example demonstrates how to retrieve the parent page of a selected page
                // in the context of a web application when you know the parent's content type.
                // If you need to retrieve a parent page of an unknown type, see the next example.

                // Retrieves the selected page (in this case, the current page) whose parent will be retrieved
                ChocolateReviewPage selectedPage = await contentRetriever.RetrieveCurrentPage<ChocolateReviewPage>();

                // Gets the id of the parent page
                // Returns '0' when the page has no parent
                int parentId = selectedPage.SystemFields.WebPageItemParentID;

                // Retrieves the parent page when the content type is known
                // This example assumes that every ChocolateReviewPage has a parent of the CandyStorePage content type
                if (parentId != 0)
                {
                    IEnumerable<CandyStorePage> parentPage = await contentRetriever.RetrievePages<CandyStorePage>(
                        new RetrievePagesParameters(),
                        query => query.Where(w => w.WhereEquals("WebPageItemID", parentId)),
                        new RetrievalCacheSettings($"WebPageItemID|{parentId}"));
                }
                else
                    throw new Exception("Parent page ID is 0, indicating that the selected page has no parent.");
            }

            /// <heading>Retrieve parent page of unknown content type</heading>
            private async void RetrieveParentPageUnknownType()
            {
                // This example demonstrates two ways to retrieve the parent page of a selected
                // page in the context of a web application when you don't know the content type
                // of the parent. The first method is simpler but results in a larger query. Use
                // the second method if you need to optimize the query. If you know the parent's
                // content type, you can use the simpler method shown in the previous example.

                // Retrieves the selected page (in this case, the current page) whose parent will be retrieved
                ChocolateReviewPage selectedPage = await contentRetriever.RetrieveCurrentPage<ChocolateReviewPage>();

                // Gets the id of the parent page
                // Returns '0' when the page has no parent
                int parentId = selectedPage.SystemFields.WebPageItemParentID;

                // Retrieves the parent page when its content type is unknown
                // This query can be inefficient if your project has a large number of content types for pages
                // However, the result is cached, so this might not be an issue depending on the use case
                if (parentId != 0)
                {
                    var parentPage = await contentRetriever.RetrieveAllPages<IWebPageFieldsSource>(
                        new RetrieveAllPagesParameters(),
                        query => query.Where(w => w.WhereEquals("WebPageItemID", parentId)),
                        new RetrievalCacheSettings($"WebPageItemID|{parentId}"));
                }
                else
                    throw new Exception("Parent page ID is 0, indicating that the selected page has no parent.");

                // The following section demonstrates an alternative method with better query optimization
                // Can be useful for projects with a large number of page content types

                // Checks that the parent page exists
                if (parentId == 0)
                {
                    throw new Exception("Parent page ID is 0, indicating that the selected page has no parent.");
                }

                // Gets the metadata of the parent page
                WebPageMetadata parentMetadata = await webPageManager.GetWebPageMetadata(parentId);

                // Id of the parent's content type
                int parentTypeID = parentMetadata.ContentTypeID;

                if (parentTypeID == 0)
                {
                    throw new Exception("The content type ID is 0, indicating that the parent is a folder");
                }
                // Content type name of the parent
                string contentTypeName = DataClassInfoProvider
                        .GetDataClassInfo(parentTypeID).ClassName;

                // Retrieves the parent page of an unknown content type in an efficient way
                IEnumerable<IWebPageFieldsSource> parentPageOption2 = await contentRetriever.RetrievePagesOfContentTypes<IWebPageFieldsSource>(
                        [contentTypeName],
                        new RetrievePagesOfContentTypesParameters(),
                        query => query.Where(w => w.WhereEquals("WebPageItemID", parentId)),
                        new RetrievalCacheSettings($"WebPageItemID|{parentId}"));
            }
        }

﻿using System;

using CMS.Websites.Routing;

using Kentico.Content.Web.Mvc.Routing;

namespace Kentico.Content.Web.Mvc
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Provides website context for the <see cref="IContentRetriever"/> service.
    /// </summary>
    internal class ContentRetrieverWebsiteContextProvider : IContentRetrieverWebsiteContextProvider
    {
        private readonly IWebPageDataContextRetriever webPageDataContextRetriever;
        private readonly IWebsiteChannelContext websiteChannelContext;
        private readonly IPreferredLanguageRetriever preferredLanguageRetriever;


        /// <summary>
        /// Initializes a new instance of the <see cref="ContentRetrieverWebsiteContextProvider"/> class.
        /// </summary>
        public ContentRetrieverWebsiteContextProvider(IWebPageDataContextRetriever webPageDataContextRetriever, IWebsiteChannelContext websiteChannelContext,
            IPreferredLanguageRetriever preferredLanguageRetriever)
        {
            this.webPageDataContextRetriever = webPageDataContextRetriever;
            this.websiteChannelContext = websiteChannelContext;
            this.preferredLanguageRetriever = preferredLanguageRetriever;
        }


        /// <inheritdoc />
        public CurrentPageWebsiteContext GetCurrentPageWebsiteContext()
        {
            ValidateWebsiteContext(true);

            var routedWebPage = webPageDataContextRetriever.Retrieve().WebPage;

            return new CurrentPageWebsiteContext()
            {
                ChannelName = routedWebPage.WebsiteChannelName,
                LanguageName = routedWebPage.LanguageName,
                WebPageItemId = routedWebPage.WebPageItemID,
                IsForPreview = websiteChannelContext.IsPreview,
                ContentTypeName = routedWebPage.ContentTypeName
            };
        }


        /// <inheritdoc />
        public PagesWebsiteContext GetPagesWebsiteContext()
        {
            ValidateWebsiteContext();

            return new PagesWebsiteContext()
            {
                ChannelName = websiteChannelContext.WebsiteChannelName,
                LanguageName = preferredLanguageRetriever.Get(),
                IsForPreview = websiteChannelContext.IsPreview
            };
        }


        /// <inheritdoc />
        public ContentItemsWebsiteContext GetContentItemsWebsiteContext()
        {
            ValidateWebsiteContext();

            return new ContentItemsWebsiteContext()
            {
                LanguageName = preferredLanguageRetriever.Get(),
                IsForPreview = websiteChannelContext.IsPreview
            };
        }


        private void ValidateWebsiteContext(bool checkCurrentPage = false)
        {
            if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(websiteChannelContext.WebsiteChannelName))
            {
                throw new InvalidOperationException("The HTTP context is not available."
                    + $" Ensure that the {nameof(IContentRetrieverWebsiteContextProvider)} is used within a valid HTTP request context.");
            }
            if (checkCurrentPage
                && (webPageDataContextRetriever.Retrieve()?.WebPage?.WebPageItemID ?? 0) == 0)
            {
                throw new InvalidOperationException("The current page context is not available.");
            }

        }
    }
}

using System;
using System.Collections.Concurrent;
using System.Linq;
using System.Threading;

using CMS.Helpers;

namespace Kentico.Content.Web.Mvc
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Collects cache dependencies within a scoped context.
    /// Supports nested contexts through the use of the 'using' statement.
    /// </summary>
    /// <remarks>
    /// <para>
    /// This class is designed to be used within a 'using' statement to ensure proper disposal and restoration of the parent context.
    /// </para>
    /// <para>
    /// The dependencies are automatically collected inside of <see cref="ContentRetriever"/>.
    /// </para>
    /// </remarks>
    public sealed class CacheDependencyCollector : IDisposable
    {
        private static readonly AsyncLocal<ConcurrentBag<CMSCacheDependency>> currentDependencies = new();
        private static readonly AsyncLocal<ConcurrentStack<ConcurrentBag<CMSCacheDependency>>> parentDependenciesStack = new();

        private bool disposed;


        /// <summary>
        /// Initializes a new instance of the <see cref="CacheDependencyCollector"/> class.
        /// Creates a new scope for cache dependency collection.
        /// </summary>
        public CacheDependencyCollector()
        {
            parentDependenciesStack.Value ??= new ConcurrentStack<ConcurrentBag<CMSCacheDependency>>();

            var previousDependencies = currentDependencies.Value;
            parentDependenciesStack.Value.Push(previousDependencies);

            currentDependencies.Value = [];
        }


        /// <summary>
        /// Adds a cache dependency to the current collection scope.
        /// </summary>
        /// <param name="dependency">The cache dependency to add.</param>
        /// <remarks>The dependency is added to the parent after the current <see cref="CacheDependencyCollector"/> is disposed.</remarks>
        /// <exception cref="ArgumentNullException">Thrown when dependency is null.</exception>
        /// <exception cref="InvalidOperationException">Thrown when not inside a CacheDependencyCollector scope.</exception>
        public static void AddCacheDependency(CMSCacheDependency dependency)
        {
            ArgumentNullException.ThrowIfNull(dependency);

            if (currentDependencies.Value is null)
            {
                throw new InvalidOperationException("CacheDependencyCollector is not initialized. Ensure you are using it within a 'using' statement.");
            }

            currentDependencies.Value.Add(dependency);
        }


        /// <summary>
        /// Gets a combined cache dependency from all dependencies collected in the current scope.
        /// </summary>
        /// <returns>A combined cache dependency.</returns>
        /// <exception cref="ObjectDisposedException">Thrown when the collector has been disposed.</exception>
        public CMSCacheDependency GetCacheDependency()
        {
            ObjectDisposedException.ThrowIf(disposed, this);

            if (currentDependencies.Value is null)
            {
                return new CMSCacheDependency();
            }

            var cacheKeys = currentDependencies.Value
                .Where(d => d.CacheKeys is not null)
                .SelectMany(d => d.CacheKeys)
                .ToArray();

            var fileNames = currentDependencies.Value
                .Where(d => d.FileNames is not null)
                .SelectMany(d => d.FileNames)
                .ToArray();

            return new CMSCacheDependency(fileNames, cacheKeys);
        }


        /// <summary>
        /// Restores the parent collection scope when this instance is disposed.
        /// </summary>
        public void Dispose()
        {
            if (disposed)
            {
                return;
            }

            if (parentDependenciesStack.Value?.TryPop(out var parentDependencies) ?? false)
            {
                if (currentDependencies.Value is not null && parentDependencies is not null)
                {
                    foreach (var dependency in currentDependencies.Value)
                    {
                        parentDependencies.Add(dependency);
                    }
                }

                currentDependencies.Value = parentDependencies;
            }
            else
            {
                currentDependencies.Value?.Clear();
            }

            disposed = true;
            GC.SuppressFinalize(this);
        }
    }
}
